name: Mercenary Captain
body:
A mercenary captain can be a leader of thugs or a more righteous band, but they always do whatever necessary to complete their goals and ensure that jobs are always fruitful for their squad.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A mercenary captain is not proficient with heavy armor. This modifies the vanguard’s normal proficiencies though may be combined with other archetypes that lessen the armor proficiencies.

Saves: A mercenary captain has good Fortitude and Reflex saves and poor Will saves. This replaces the vanguards normal save bonuses.

It’s Just Business (Ex)

A mercenary captain may invest mettle into the contract for a job at the time the deal is struck. Doing so allows a mercenary captain to act outside their code of honor without penalty. As long as the contract has yet to be fulfilled they begin each day with one less point of mettle and actions taken in pursuit of a contract do not affect or change the mercenary captain’s alignment. This alters code of honor.

Test of Valor (Ex)

A mercenary captain does not regain their test of valor bonuses against an opponent who surrenders as a deception. This modifies the vanguard’s test of valor.

All’s Fair (Ex)

At 2nd level, a mercenary captain gains Combat Expertise and Improved Dirty Trick as bonus feats. At 7th level, they gain Greater Dirty Trick and at 12th level, they gain Quick Dirty Trick.

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian.

Battlefield Acumen (Ex)

A 2nd-level mercenary captain gains a bonus equal to 1/2 their class level (rounded down) on Knowledge (geography), Perception checks to notice hidden enemies and on Sense Motive to avoid being feinted. Allies within 10 feet gain a bonus on these same checks equal to 1/4 the mercenary captains class levels (minimum +1).

This ability replaces aristocratic training.

Let’s Make a Deal (Ex)

Beginning at 2nd level, whenever a mercenary captain is selling goods in a settlement where they have completed contracts they do so at a rate of 60% rather than 1/2. Their reputation as reliable and profitable to their benefactors spreads through the circles in which they operate.

This ability replaces shield focus.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 3rd level, a mercenary captain gains sneak attack as the rogue ability, dealing an extra 1d6 damage against foes denied their dexterity bonus to AC or being flanked by the mercenary captain. This ability deals an additional 1d6 for every 3 class levels the mercenary captain possesses.

This ability replaces behind me, active defense, brace and bulwark.

Any Advantage (Ex)

At 7th level, the mercenary captain gains the bleeding attack rogue talent and also gains Flensing Strike as a bonus feat. At 12th level whenever the mercenary captain uses Flensing Strike they may also reduce the targets damage reduction, if any, by the same amount they would reduce their natural armor.

This ability replaces press the advantage and improved press the advantage.

Talented (Ex)

In place of a bonus combat feat a mercenary captain may gain either a rogue talent or a vigilante social talent. The mercenary captain uses their class level in place of a rogue or vigilante level when choosing these talents.

This ability alters combat feats.

Mercenary General (Ex)

At 20th level, the reputation of the mercenary captain has grown to the point that they are recognized among the greatest generals alive today. It takes only a DC 5 knowledge (nobility or history) check to identify the mercenary captain and any creature with an intelligence score of 5 or higher that identifies the mercenary captain has their attitude shifted one step towards helpful unless a past action taken by the mercenary captain harmed them in some way. The mercenary captain is also awarded with honors nearly everywhere they go, they never pay for lodging in settlements where they fulfilled contracts and they may call on those they have served in the past for aid worth up to 100 gp per mercenary captain level once per month and 1,000 gp per mercenary captain level once per year. This is still limited by the settlement rules but may take the form of goods, hirelings, magic items or anything else that could reasonably provided.

This ability replaces protector of the realm.
